Container.Name: spoolman
Container.Overview: Spoolman, included with Print Buddy: filament and spool records Print Buddy reads and updates. Install together with Print Buddy Bot and Print Buddy Listener. Keep the container name spoolman, and put all three containers on the same custom Docker network so the name spoolman resolves; on the default bridge network Print Buddy cannot reach it by name (see docs/DOCKER.md). Starting this container changes no spool or printer state by itself.
Container.ExtraParams: --memory 512m --log-driver json-file --log-opt max-size=10m --log-opt max-file=3 --restart unless-stopped --health-cmd "python3 -c \"import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health', timeout=5)\"" --health-interval 30s --health-timeout 10s --health-start-period 30s --health-retries 3
Container.Requires: Print Buddy Bot and Print Buddy Listener from the tested Print Buddy image, on the same custom Docker network as this container.

Config.Name: Spoolman data
Config.Description: Spoolman database and data. Persists across container recreation. Back this up; never delete it to switch to an external Spoolman.

Config.Name: Web UI / API port
Config.Description: Publishes the Spoolman UI/API on the Unraid host LAN port. Needed for browser access, and as the fallback route if Print Buddy does not share a Docker network with this container. LAN only: never forward this port from the router or expose it publicly.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone Spoolman displays times in, an IANA name such as UTC.
